floor_props.fringe: short dark brown/tan; no bright white band

effects.note: Upper flame-only crop; no floating logs. Flames rise from potion rim.

revision_notes: Added independent wizard idle sprite based on original character design, with foot and hand anchors and visibility toggle.
Rebuilt celestial blue/ivory/gold tea service, adding sugar bowl and separate spoon.
Recessed fireplace has visible floor slab; cauldron has three recorded floor contacts.
Replaced adjacent odd arched alcove with conventional narrow straight bookcase.
Replaced ladder with nearly upright sprite, two floor contacts and visible brass rail.
Cleared vines from ladder/gargoyle and central workbench; muted chair to oxblood brown.
Replaced white-fringe carpet with low wool pile and short dark fringe.
Redrew armillary sphere with shallow base perspective and upright stem.

compositing.furnishings.png: Exported from the exact same shelf/rug/static-prop/decor placement data as preview; alpha-only full-canvas static overlay. Interactive sprites and hearth effects excluded.
compositing.ordering: Use sorted runtime layers to support object/foreground depth. Flattened overlay is a convenience for static assembly.
compositing.projective_mapping: Bilinear mesh with 20x12 cells and 2 triangles per cell; source and target quads are stored in JSON.
